So.... I am incredibly lucky to spend almost all of my working life with Australian cows and cow people, but, the real icing on my cow vet cake is that I am often accompanied by some of the best vet students in the world!  

They asked me to set up a channel... so here it is!

Born in Wild Horse Colorado, Trained at Colorado State University, Practicing in Esperance Western Australia, I have dedicated my career to improving the profitability of Australian beef producers without sacrificing welfare outcomes.
